#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();
    string input;
    getline(cin, input);

    int longestOutside = 0;
    int insideWordCount = 0;
    int currentOutsideLength = 0;
    bool insideParenthesis = false;
    bool hasCurrentInsideWord = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = input[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '(':
                if (currentOutsideLength > longestOutside) {
                    longestOutside = currentOutsideLength;
                }
                currentOutsideLength = 0;
                insideParenthesis = true;
                break;

            case ')':
                insideParenthesis = false;
                if (hasCurrentInsideWord) {
                    insideWordCount++;
                }
                hasCurrentInsideWord = false;
                break;

            case '_':
                if (currentOutsideLength > longestOutside) {
                    longestOutside = currentOutsideLength;
                }
                currentOutsideLength = 0;
                if (hasCurrentInsideWord) {
                    insideWordCount++;
                }
                hasCurrentInsideWord = false;
                break;

            default:
                if (insideParenthesis) {
                    hasCurrentInsideWord = true;
                } else {
                    currentOutsideLength++;
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    if (currentOutsideLength > longestOutside) {
        longestOutside = currentOutsideLength;
    }

    cout << longestOutside << " " << insideWordCount << endl;
    return 0;
}
